claim: DOJ and its linked administrator FAQ/header state 2026-12-31 for Phase 3 petitions, while two homepage body instructions still state 2026-08-19. This is a contradiction in published instructions, not proof of wrongful denial or a changed legal deadline.

observations.description: DOJ Oct 7 notice states Dec 31 deadline.
Administrator homepage Aug 5 update extends original Aug 19 deadline to Dec 31, 2026.
Administrator homepage paragraphs on initial and supplemental petitions retain Aug 19, 2026 filing instructions.
No person-level intake, rejection or harm evidence; no test petition submitted.

testCases.purpose: Compare dated official instructions and legal hierarchy; preserve stale wording and controlling deadline
Verify administrator accepts eligible Dec 31 petitions
Verify adjudication, appeal and actual payments
testCases.execution: NOT EXECUTED; no individual data or receipt

limitations: Source pages may be updated after observation
Published contradiction does not establish actual claim rejection
DOJ statement and administrator site are not independent evidence of individual payment
No complete denominator of eligible claimants
